instructions: Water every 1-2 weeks, allowing soil to dry out between waterings. Expect to water more often in brighter light and less often in lower light. Keep away from cold drafts.
sunlightRequirements: Bright, indirect light. Can tolerate medium indirect light.
humidity: High (60%+). Mist regularly or use a humidifier.
toxicityWarnings: Toxic to cats and dogs if ingested. Can cause oral irritation.

instructions: Allow soil to dry completely between waterings. Very drought tolerant. Water sparingly in winter. Overwatering is the main cause of death.
sunlightRequirements: Low to bright indirect light. Extremely adaptable.
humidity: Low to average. Tolerates dry air.
toxicityWarnings: Mildly toxic to pets. May cause nausea if ingested.

instructions: Water every 1-2 weeks, allowing soil to dry out halfway down between waterings. Yellowing leaves indicate overwatering; brown tips indicate underwatering.
sunlightRequirements: Low to medium indirect light. Tolerates fluorescent light.
toxicityWarnings: Toxic to pets and humans if ingested. Causes mouth irritation.

instructions: Water every 1-2 weeks, allowing soil to dry out between waterings. Hates being moved; find a stable bright spot. Wipe leaves monthly to remove dust.
sunlightRequirements: Bright, indirect light. Can handle some direct morning sun.
toxicityWarnings: Mildly toxic to pets. Sap may irritate skin.

instructions: Water every 2-3 weeks, allowing soil to dry completely. Highly drought-resistant due to rhizomes that store water. Reduce watering in winter.
sunlightRequirements: Low to bright indirect light. Avoid direct sunlight.
soilType: Well-draining potting mix or cactus mix.
toxicityWarnings: Toxic to pets and humans if ingested. Wash hands after handling.

instructions: Keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged. The plant will droop dramatically when thirsty — a reliable watering signal. Use filtered water if possible.
sunlightRequirements: Low to medium indirect light. One of the best low-light bloomers.
toxicityWarnings: Toxic to cats, dogs, and humans. All parts can cause irritation.

instructions: Water deeply but infrequently. Allow soil to dry out completely between waterings. Reduce watering in winter. Plant in terracotta pot for best drainage.
sunlightRequirements: Bright, direct to indirect light. 6+ hours of sunlight.
toxicityWarnings: Toxic to cats and dogs. Gel is safe for humans topically but toxic if ingested.

instructions: Water moderately, allowing soil to dry slightly between waterings. Produces 'babies' (spiderettes) that can be propagated. Very forgiving plant.
sunlightRequirements: Moderate to bright indirect light. Avoid direct sun.
toxicityWarnings: Non-toxic to pets and humans. Safe household plant.

instructions: Water only when top inch of soil is dry. Reduce watering significantly in winter. Overwatering causes root rot. Can live for decades with proper care.
sunlightRequirements: Bright light, some direct sun. 4+ hours daily.
toxicityWarnings: Toxic to cats and dogs. Can cause vomiting and lethargy.

instructions: Water when top 2 inches of soil are dry. Wipe leaves with damp cloth monthly to keep them glossy and enable photosynthesis. Prefers consistent conditions.
sunlightRequirements: Bright, indirect light. Can handle some direct morning sun.
toxicityWarnings: Mildly toxic to pets and humans. Sap can cause skin irritation.

instructions: Allow top half of soil to dry out between waterings. Very sensitive to fluoride in tap water — use filtered or distilled water. Brown tips often indicate fluoride toxicity.
sunlightRequirements: Low to bright indirect light. Avoid direct sun.
humidity: Average. Does not like dry heat.
toxicityWarnings: Toxic to cats and dogs. Can cause vomiting and dilated pupils.

instructions: Keep soil consistently moist but not soggy. Use distilled or rainwater. Leaves fold up at night (prayer plant movement). Very sensitive to mineral-heavy water.
sunlightRequirements: Medium to bright indirect light. No direct sun.
humidity: Very high (60%+). Use humidifier or pebble tray.
toxicityWarnings: Non-toxic to pets and humans. Great pet-friendly choice.

instructions: Water when top inch of soil is dry. Prefers cooler temperatures. Great for hanging baskets. Can remove airborne pollutants. Prone to spider mites in dry air.
sunlightRequirements: Bright to medium indirect light.
toxicityWarnings: Toxic to cats, dogs, and humans. All parts are poisonous.

instructions: Allow top inch of soil to dry between waterings. One of the most forgiving houseplants. Propagates easily in water. Trailing or climbing habit.
sunlightRequirements: Low to bright indirect light.
toxicityWarnings: Toxic to cats and dogs. Causes oral irritation.

instructions: Allow soil to dry halfway down before watering. Rotate weekly for even growth. Produces many 'pups' around the base that can be separated and shared.
sunlightRequirements: Bright, indirect light. Avoid direct sun.
toxicityWarnings: Non-toxic to pets and humans.

instructions: Use the 'soak and dry' method — water thoroughly then let soil completely dry. Avoid getting water on rosette leaves to prevent rot. Thrives in terracotta pots.
sunlightRequirements: Full sun to bright indirect light. 6+ hours.
toxicityWarnings: Non-toxic to pets and humans.

instructions: Water regularly in growing season, reduce in winter. Large plant that needs space. Can bloom indoors with enough bright light. Wipe large leaves monthly.
sunlightRequirements: Bright direct to indirect light. 4-6 hours of direct sun.
toxicityWarnings: Mildly toxic to pets. Seeds and skin of fruit are toxic.

instructions: Allow top inch of soil to dry before watering. Blooms nearly year-round with enough light. Avoid cold drafts and standing water. Prefers filtered water.
sunlightRequirements: Bright, indirect light. No direct sun.
soilType: Orchid mix or chunky, airy potting mix.
toxicityWarnings: Toxic to cats, dogs, and humans. Causes oral irritation.

instructions: Keep soil evenly moist. Leaves fold upward at night like praying hands. Very sensitive to fluoride — use distilled water. Great low-light option.
sunlightRequirements: Low to medium indirect light.
toxicityWarnings: Non-toxic to pets and humans.

instructions: Water thoroughly, then let soil dry out between waterings. Often sold with braided trunks. Avoid overwatering which leads to root rot. Rotate for even growth.
sunlightRequirements: Bright, indirect light.
toxicityWarnings: Non-toxic to pets and humans.

instructions: Water sparingly — the swollen trunk base stores water. One of the most drought-tolerant houseplants. Allow soil to completely dry between waterings.
sunlightRequirements: Bright direct to indirect light.
humidity: Low. Very tolerant of dry air.
toxicityWarnings: Non-toxic to pets and humans.

instructions: Allow top inch of soil to dry between waterings. Fast-growing and easy to propagate. Pinch stems to encourage bushy growth. Striking purple and silver foliage.
sunlightRequirements: Bright indirect light. Better color in more light.
toxicityWarnings: Mildly toxic to pets. May cause skin irritation in humans.

instructions: One of the most indestructible houseplants. Water when top 2 inches are dry. Tolerates neglect, low light, dust, and irregular watering remarkably well.
sunlightRequirements: Low to medium indirect light. No direct sun.
toxicityWarnings: Non-toxic to pets and humans.

instructions: Allow top half of soil to dry between waterings. Slow growing but very elegant. Great for low-light corners. Wipe fronds to remove dust. Sensitive to overwatering.
sunlightRequirements: Low to bright indirect light.
toxicityWarnings: Non-toxic to pets and humans.

instructions: Water when top inch is dry. Goes dormant periodically — reduce water and it will return. Leaves fold at night and reopen with morning light.
sunlightRequirements: Bright indirect light. Some direct morning sun is fine.
toxicityWarnings: Toxic to cats and dogs if ingested in large amounts. Contains oxalic acid.
